about_the_game:
With this exclusive DLC you dive into the world of the Altano TDX featuring two outstanding variants of a long-distance bus that stand out with a special innovation. The Altano TDX has an extra large front door, offering your passengers an incomparably comfortable entry and exit on their journeys across the continent.

This extra large front door redefines the Altano TDX and sets new standards in passenger comfort. It not only allows for fast boarding and disembarking, but also creates a welcoming atmosphere when entering and exiting the bus.

The cockpit of the Altano TDX continues to focus on the comfort and well-being of the driver. Already at first glance it exudes a high quality. It impresses with an elegant interior design made of high-quality materials and easy to use.

Expand your fleet with the Altano TDX with this special feature and offer your passengers an unparalleled travel experience with maximum comfort and convenience when boarding and disembarking!

Variants included:


  • TDX20
  • TDX21
